Title: These Foot Patches Turn Black Overnight (It's Not What You Think)

Description:
Perorin's foot patch, found at Don Quijote in Osaka, goes a step further than the mugwort-only version Daiso already sells in Korea — this one adds wood vinegar and houttuynia, and it comes in four different scents. The patch turns visibly dark brown by morning, but Japanese verification blogs have confirmed the color change comes from the wood vinegar absorbing sweat, not toxins leaving your body. Users report smoother, less rough skin over time, though how fast varies a lot — anywhere from one week to ten weeks.
